_comment: Every product worth building. `items` are one-offs; `sweeps` expand their axes into every combination. Validated against each generator's own options, so a typo here fails in seconds rather than in a hundred build jobs.

release.name: storage-shelving
release.title: Storage Shelving
release.summary: Hanging bin racks for the GreenMade Mini Bin, folding bins that collapse flat onto their own floors, advent calendars of numbered snap-lid boxes that clip together into one piece, and the fit gauge that measures your bin so the rails match it. Nothing in the release needs support material.

items.name: bin-shelf_greenmade-mini_2x2_desk
items._comment: headroom is raised to clear the 18 mm label plate, so a bin lifts straight out instead of having to be tilted

items.name: folding-bin_greenmade-rack
items._comment: sized to hang from the same rails as the moulded bin, so it drops into any rack in this release

items.name: advent-calendar_tree_brick
items._comment: the default: 25 boxes as a tree, tree motif with a star at the tip, brick outside

sweeps.name: folding-bin_{width}x{depth}x{height}_{pattern}
sweeps._comment: wall height is bounded by the bin's own footprint -- folded, each pair meets in the middle -- and the base is the widest part, so these combinations stay inside both that limit and a 256 mm bed
